content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIEST Shibpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026 is 14-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the posts of Research Associate/Scientific Officer and Technical Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate/Scientific Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate/Scientific Officer post, candidates must have a PhD in Engineering/Science with at least two years of post-doctoral research or industrial experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the IIEST Shibpur posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this recruitment is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Technical Assistant position offers a salary of Rs. 50000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a committee review and an interaction with the selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Which city and state is IIEST Shibpur located in?
faq.answer: IIEST Shibpur is located in Howrah, West Bengal.
